name: ai-engineering-os
description: Reusable engineering-discipline capabilities for Claude Code: planning before execution, project memory, adversarial review, and domain skills installed per project.

plugins.name: core-discipline
plugins.description: Plan before executing and remember what matters across sessions. Install once at user scope; applies to every project.

plugins.name: quality
plugins.description: A gate before work is called done, at a depth proportional to what the change can break. Install per project; promote to user scope only if the ambient budget allows.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Python development discipline and deep-module architecture review. Install per project, in repositories with real code.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: ICM: folder structure as agent architecture, for building a workspace or restructuring an existing one. Install where the structure itself is the work.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Interface review and strategic web design. Install per project, in repositories with a user-facing surface.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research with source tiers and a stopping criterion, and option comparison that states its criteria and its missing data before recommending. Domain-neutral.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Macro-financial news triage scored against a tracked investment universe. Domain-specific: install only in projects that follow markets.
